milestone.title: clippy: resolve remaining 53 warnings in mp + raul; clean baseline for CI adopt (M-CI)

intent.outcome: mp and raul compile with zero clippy warnings. This gives M-CI a clean --warn baseline where any new warning introduced in a PR fails CI.

problem.description: clippy reports 57 warnings across mp and raul (beyond the 4 too_many_arguments already handled in M127). Left unfixed, a clippy --warn CI gate would fail on every PR due to pre-existing noise. The warnings span auto-fixable (redundant closures, collapsible if/match), correctness (spawned process not wait()ed), and style tiers (doc list indentation, immediately dereferenced refs).

in_scope: Tier 1 — auto-fixable (run cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty): redundant closures (10x in session.rs, search.rs), collapsible if (5x in bootstrap.rs, milestone.rs), useless format! (3x in render.rs, changelog.rs), unneeded return (1x in markdown.rs), clone on Copy (1x in ac_verify.rs), derive impl (1x in path_engine.rs), repeat().take() concise (1x in render.rs), const initializer for thread_local (1x in markdown.rs), map_or simplify (1x in main.rs), let...else→? (1x in plan_diff.rs), match unwrap_or_default (1x in milestone.rs)
Tier 2 — spawned process not wait()ed (3x in crates/raul/src/commands/digest.rs:128,138,140): these are correctness bugs — the child process must be waited on to avoid zombie processes
Tier 3 — doc list indentation (6x in spec.rs, plan_io.rs, tui_*.rs): doc comments need proper indentation on list items
Tier 4 — immediately dereferenced compiler-created refs (6x in render.rs, runner.rs): clippy emits a temporary reference that is immediately dereferenced; suppress or restructure
Tier 5 — collapsible match into outer match (4x in app.rs:413,478 and runner.rs:332+1 more): if let Some(x) inside match arm can merge into match arm pattern
Tier 6 — if with identical blocks (2x in doctor.rs:9,11): two branches do the same thing
Tier 7 — unused imports (1x): effective_execution_status and effective_spec_status imported but not used
Verify full clean: cargo clippy --all-targets exits 0 on both mp and raul
out_of_scope: too_many_arguments (M127 — already scoped and in progress)
too_many_arguments remaining (9/7 and 8/7 thresholds — these are resolved by M127 struct refactors for the 12-arg case; 9/7 in list.rs and 8/7 in path_graph.rs are acceptable at the threshold)
large_size_difference in milestone.rs enum — design decision, deferred to M-Clippy-Design
Default impl for App — nice to have but not blocking CI
Behavioral changes — only fixes to silence warnings, no logic changes

Total ~25 warnings. Verified by cargo clippy after fixes.

work_packages.name: Tier 1: auto-fixable clippy warnings (cargo clippy --fix)
work_packages.goal: Run cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty on mp and raul. This auto-resolves: redundant closures (10x), collapsible if (5x), useless format! (3x), unneeded return (1x), clone on Copy (1x), derive impl (1x), repeat().take() concise (1x), const thread_local init (1x), map_or simplify (1x), let...else→? (1x), match unwrap_or_default (1x). Review the diff and verify all auto-fixes are correct (no logic changes). ~25 warnings. AC-01.

work_packages.name: Tier 2: spawned process not wait()ed (correctness)
work_packages.goal: Fix the 3 occurrences of 'spawned process is not wait()ed' in crates/raul/src/commands/digest.rs:128,138,140. Each child process must be waited on to avoid zombie processes. This is a correctness bug, not just a style issue. Verify after fix: cargo clippy exits 0 and the process wait logic is correct. AC-02 part 1.

AC-02 part 2 and AC-03.

work_packages.name: Final verification: full clippy baseline clean
work_packages.goal: Full clippy baseline: cargo clippy --all-targets exits 0 on both mp and raul with zero warnings. cargo test -p mp -p raul green. AC-03.

steps.action: Run cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty on mp and raul. This auto-resolves ~25 warnings: redundant closures (session.rs, search.rs, 10x), collapsible if (bootstrap.rs, milestone.rs, 5x), useless format! (render.rs, changelog.rs, 3x), unneeded return (markdown.rs, 1x), clone on Copy (ac_verify.rs, 1x), derive impl (path_engine.rs, 1x), repeat().take concise (render.rs, 1x), const thread_local init (markdown.rs, 1x), map_or simplify (main.rs, 1x), let...else→? (plan_diff.rs, 1x), match unwrap_or_default (milestone.rs, 1x). Review the diff; assert no logic changes were introduced.
steps.done_when: cargo clippy exits 0 on mp and raul; no auto-fixable warnings remain

steps.action: Fix the 3 occurrences of 'spawned process is not wait()ed on in all code paths' in crates/raul/src/commands/digest.rs:128,138,140. Each child process must be .wait()ed or the Command chain must use .output()/.status() synchronously. This is a correctness bug (zombie processes). Verify: cargo clippy exits 0 and child processes are properly waited.
steps.done_when: cargo clippy -p raul exits 0; no 'spawned process' warnings in digest.rs

steps.action: Fix remaining manual/style warnings across mp and raul: Tier 3 — doc list item without indentation (6x: spec.rs:6,7 / plan_io.rs:9 / tui_*.rs 3 more); Tier 4 — immediately dereferenced refs (6x: render.rs:1536 / runner.rs:630,640 / tui_*.rs 3 more — suppress with #[allow or restructure); Tier 5 — collapsible match into outer match (4x: app.rs:413,478 / runner.rs:332 / tui_*.rs 1 more); Tier 6 — identical if blocks (2x: doctor.rs:9,11); Tier 7 — unused imports (1x: ac_verify.rs effective_execution_status/effective_spec_status). Note: path_graph.rs recursive-param and render.rs unwrap-after-is_some are low-risk suppressions if refactor is disproportionate.
steps.done_when: cargo clippy exits 0 on mp and raul; no remaining doc/indent/deref/collapsible/identical-if/unused warnings

steps.action: Full clippy baseline verification: cargo clippy --all-targets exits 0 on both mp and raul with zero warnings. cargo test -p mp -p raul green. mp validate --summary exits 0. mp reviews pass for M129. Set evidence on all steps.
